game_updates.contents: We have a new hotfix for you today that addresses the following issues:Fixed an issue where favorite servers would not be saved between sessions.Fixed an issue where filtering servers by favorites showed all servers as favorites.Dedicated servers can opt-in to send us crash reports with the launch argument -SendUnattendedBugReportsServer admins can launch with this option if experiencing server crashes to give us information to investigateFix an issue that was preventing servers with an IPv6 address from showing up in the server browserFixed an issue that was preventing the client from showing previously played servers

game_updates.title: New Slay the Spire 2 update deletes its most controversial boss fight
game_updates.contents: The Doormaker is dead. Mega Crit's new Slay the Spire 2 update has just landed on the beta branch, and the developer has finally made the decision to put its most divisive enemy to bed and start fresh with a completely new creation. These latest StS 2 patch notes also introduce the first incarnation of the Bestiary, and a fresh helping of balance changes for the roguelike deckbuilder, led by some fairly notable Defect buffs. game_updates.title: KARDS Permanent Card Pool List
game_updates.contents: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/94bcfbef7dc7c64f7e60cebd9eee5d169c216ace.jpg Hello Commanders, Today we're publishing the full list of cards in the permanent pool - the strategic backbone of KARDS under the new rotation system. The permanent pool is the set of cards that will never rotate out of the active pool. These are the cards you can safely craft, build around, and rely on regardless of what each new expansion brings. With this expanded core now in place, the active pool will hold between 800 and 900 cards at all times, giving every Commander a stable and diverse foundation for long-term deckbuilding. game_updates.title: Beta Patch Notes - v0.105.0
game_updates.contents: It's beta patch time! For those new to Slay the Spire 2, keep in mind that these changes are pushed to our Beta branch to ensure stability, then eventually merged into the main branch. For those who play using controller, we highly recommend using the Beta branch as we're trying to resolve crashes related to selection screens when playing via controller/Steam Deck. While our focus is still on fixing crashes and ensuring the game runs on as many hardware configurations as possible, let's look at some of this patch's highlights. Bi-Weekly Patching As you've probably noticed, we're moving to patch every 2 weeks rather than weekly as outlined in our Early Access Disclaimer. game_updates.title: Hotfix 726875
game_updates.contents: Bug Fixes Fixed creatures like Chester that follow a carried item still following the holder of the item when the item is dropped from a distance. Fixed crash when using shift-click to transfer items out of containers like Expansive Storage Unit, Ammo Pouch, Battle Call Canister, Picnic Casket, etc. Fixed client prediction sometimes failing after transforming into Wonkey. Fixed Exploiterators and Auto-Grabbers stopping from following WX-78 after minigames. Fixed mutating Puffins being invisible. Fixed Possessed Chassis getting stuck when they’re unable to find a suitable spot to attack. Fixed Possessed Chassis trying to use Zaptrocuter on creatures that can’t be hit by its projectile.
